title: Bug : Profile % doesn't change back
symptom: After an automation triggers a temporary target and low profile for 15 minutes, the temporary target returns to normal but the profile percentage stays stuck at the low value and does not change back automatically. It requires manual reset.
fix: The user resolved the issue by force closing AAPS and clearing cache, then clearing APS results and cleaning (not resetting) the database in AAPS. However, the user is unsure which action helped.
evidence_quote: Force close AAPS and clear cache. Clear APS results and clean (not _reset_ ) db in AAPS.
